public_mechanism.family: Git expected-old atomic ref update / transaction prepare-commit-abort
source_supported_core: an update with new-oid and old-oid applies only after verifying the current ref equals old-oid
a transaction can be started, prepared, committed, or aborted
a transaction automatically aborts if its session ends without explicit commit
prepare aborts if a queued ref cannot be locked
when refs cannot all be locked with matching old values, no modifications are performed
public_mechanism.adaptation: Use the same expected-old/abort semantics with the role-local repository pointer CAS already available as lightweight durable transport; no Git CLI execution is required.

chat_reduction.prepare: write immutable replacement checkpoint first; do not move active pointer
chat_reduction.commit: CAS the active role-local pointer only when its current blob equals the exact predecessor blob
chat_reduction.abort: CAS mismatch or write/readback failure leaves the prior pointer authoritative and gives the prepared checkpoint zero semantic credit
chat_reduction.dedup: a stale retry still presents the old predecessor blob and therefore cannot apply after a successful commit
chat_reduction.readback: new pointer must be independently read back before it is used for continuation or credit

scope_limit: Constructed role-local assignment-switch commit/abort trace only. This does not establish multi-resource serializability, distributed transaction correctness, or Git ref-transaction equivalence beyond the expected-old abort property used here.
exact_next_action: After independent readback, advance once with credit_delta=1. Next leaf should test priority inversion during recovery: an older low-value pending repair must not indefinitely block a newly urgent safe assignment, while preemption must preserve resumability and cannot erase prior evidence. Precommit the comparison before any new public semantic read.
